items.title: Itatiaia (RJ) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #CRE 4
items.en_title: Itatiaia (RJ) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #CRE 4
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itatiaia (RJ) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 7,450; proposals close Nov 25, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
